description: This is a balancing thing, I hope it's fun but I am not listing numbers because after testing I am probably going to want to change them, I hope they are cool and honestly I wanted to do more but I am not good with Java. I prefer *fun* over perfect balance, so I am not looking to make things that are completely foolproof.
